import argparse
import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('lane', choices=['latest', 'baseline'])
parser.add_argument('label')
parser.add_argument('--cwd', default='.')
parser.add_argument('--stdout')
parser.add_argument('--env', action='append', default=[])
parser.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
args = parser.parse_args()
# Options precede the lane/label so REMAINDER preserves command flags.
root = Path('/home/ubuntu/.herdr/worktrees/mad-dom/herdr-plan-bun-native-runtime-07-integration')
out = Path('/tmp/mad-dom-task07-evidence')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out / 'logs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env = os.environ.copy()
runtime = Path('/tmp/mad-dom-task04-memory/baseline/bun-linux-x64/bun') if args.lane == 'baseline' else Path(shutil.which('bun'))
env.update(PATH=str(runtime.parent) + os.pathsep + env['PATH'], CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='3',
           MAD_DOM_NATIVE_PATH=str(root / 'build/mad-dom.node'), MAD_DOM_FFI_PATH=str(root / 'build/mad-dom.node'),
           BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR=str(out / 'cache' / 'default'))
env.pop('MAD_DOM_FFI_DISABLED', None)
env.pop('MAD_DOM_BUN_IO_DISABLED', None)
for pair in args.env:
    key, value = pair.split('=', 1)
    env[key] = value
command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ['--'] else args.command
log = out / 'logs' / (args.label + '.log')
if log.exists():
    raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite evidence: ' + str(log))
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
start = time.monotonic()
with log.open('wb') as err:
    dest = open(args.stdout, 'wb') if args.stdout else err
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root / args.cwd, env=env, stdout=dest, stderr=err, timeout=1800)
        code = proc.returncode
    finally:
        if args.stdout:
            dest.close()
record = dict(label=args.label, lane=args.lane, command=command, cwd=str(root / args.cwd),
              environment={k: env[k] for k in ['PATH', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'MAD_DOM_NATIVE_PATH', 'MAD_DOM_FFI_PATH', 'BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR'] + [p.split('=',1)[0] for p in args.env]},
              started=started, elapsedSeconds=round(time.monotonic()-start, 3), exitCode=code,
              log=str(log), stdout=args.stdout)
with (out / 'commands.jsonl').open('a') as manifest:
    manifest.write(json.dumps(record) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
print('\n'.join(log.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()[-22:]), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(code)
